title: ICAB P4 - Financial Management
summary: Advanced corporate finance, capital structure, cost of capital (WACC), investment appraisal under uncertainty, business valuation, treasury risk management, and ESG finance.

all.name: Full Syllabus Tracker
all.blurb: Official 2025 Syllabus chapter and topic tracker for Financial Management. Track your study progress across all syllabus areas.

stages.title: Area 1: Business Finance – Methods & Strategies
stages.name: Area 1: Business Finance – Methods & Strategies
stages.description: Cost of capital, WACC, capital structure theories (Modigliani-Miller), and dividend policy.

nodes.name: Cost of Capital (WACC) & Capital Structure Theories
nodes.description: Cost of equity using CAPM and Dividend Growth Model; cost of debt (irredeemable, redeemable, convertible); calculation of Weighted Average Cost of Capital (WACC); capital structure theories: Traditional view, Modigliani-Miller with and without corporate taxes, pecking order theory; dividend policy theories and signaling.
topics: Cost of equity calculation: Capital Asset Pricing Model (CAPM) and Gordon Growth Model
Systematic vs unsystematic risk, Beta estimation, de-gearing and re-gearing betas
Cost of redeemable debt using internal rate of return (IRR) interpolation
Cost of convertible bonds and floor value analysis
Weighted Average Cost of Capital (WACC) calculation and conditions for use in appraisal
Capital structure debate: Traditional view vs MM Proposition I & II (tax shield)
Pecking order hypothesis, trade-off theory, and financial distress costs
Dividend irrelevance (MM) vs Walter/Gordon models, clientele effect, signaling
learningOutcomes: Calculate WACC for complex financing structures.
Evaluate capital structure decisions applying MM theories.
De-gear and re-gear equity betas for investment projects.
checklists: Solve 3 complex WACC calculations with convertible debt
Master asset beta formula: Beta_A = Beta_E * (E/(E+D(1-t)))
resources: Relevant Acts & Standards (IFRS / ISA / Tax Acts)

stages.title: Area 2: Investment Appraisal & Business Valuation
stages.name: Area 2: Investment Appraisal & Business Valuation
stages.description: Discounted cash flow (DCF), sensitivity, real options, M&A, and company valuation methods.

nodes.name: DCF Appraisal, Risk Analysis & Business Valuation
nodes.description: Net Present Value (NPV), IRR, MIRR, Payback; dealing with inflation, taxation, and capital rationing; sensitivity analysis and simulation; real options (delay, expand, abandon); business valuation methods: Asset-based, Earnings multiples (P/E, EV/EBITDA), Free Cash Flow to Firm (FCFF) and Equity (FCFE).
topics: NPV analysis incorporating working capital, tax depreciation allowances, and residual values
Inflation in investment appraisal: Real discount rate vs nominal cash flows (Fisher equation)
Single-period capital rationing: Profitability Index (PI) ranking
Multi-period capital rationing and linear programming principles
Risk in investment appraisal: Sensitivity analysis, scenario analysis, real options value
Business valuation approaches: Net Asset Value (NAV), book value vs liquidation value
Earnings-based valuation: P/E multiples, EV/EBITDA, earnings yield method
Discounted Free Cash Flow valuation: FCFF discounted at WACC, FCFE discounted at Ke
Mergers and acquisitions: Valuation of synergies and defense against hostile bids
learningOutcomes: Formulate advanced DCF models with tax shields and capital rationing.
Value private and public companies using FCFF and market multiple methods.
Quantify real options in high-uncertainty capital investments.
checklists: Read DCF Appraisal, Risk Analysis & Business Valuation in ICAB Study Manual
resources: Relevant Acts & Standards (IFRS / ISA / Tax Acts)

stages.title: Area 3: Treasury & Financial Risk Management
stages.name: Area 3: Treasury & Financial Risk Management
stages.description: Currency and interest rate risk management using forwards, futures, options, and swaps.

nodes.name: FX Hedging, Interest Rate Risk & Derivatives
nodes.description: Foreign exchange risk exposure: Transaction, translation, and economic risk; hedging techniques: Forward contracts, money market hedges, futures, currency options, currency swaps; interest rate risk: Forward Rate Agreements (FRAs), interest rate futures, options (caps, floors, collars), interest rate swaps.
topics: Foreign exchange exposure types: Transaction, translation, economic risk
Internal hedging techniques: Invoicing in home currency, netting, matching, leading/lagging
External FX hedging: Forward contracts vs Money market hedge step-by-step comparison
Currency futures and options hedging: Call vs Put option strategies
Interest rate risk sources: Gap analysis, basis risk
Forward Rate Agreements (FRAs) structure, fixing rates, and settlement calculations
Interest rate swaps: Comparative advantage argument, mechanics, counterparty risk
Options on interest rates: Caps, Floors, Collars construction and cost optimization
learningOutcomes: Construct money market hedges for FX payments and receipts.
Hedge floating interest rate exposure using FRAs and interest rate swaps.
Design option collar strategies to bound interest rate costs.
checklists: Read FX Hedging, Interest Rate Risk & Derivatives in ICAB Study Manual
resources: Relevant Acts & Standards (IFRS / ISA / Tax Acts)

stages.title: Area 4: Sustainable Finance, ESG & FinTech
stages.name: Area 4: Sustainable Finance, ESG & FinTech
stages.description: Green bonds, ESG investment metrics, FinTech innovations, and climate risk finance.

nodes.name: Green Finance, ESG Integration & Financial Technology
nodes.description: Role of sustainable finance and Bangladesh Bank Green Banking Policy; green bonds, sustainability-linked loans (SLL); ESG ratings and investment screening; financial technology (FinTech): Mobile financial services (bKash/Nagad), blockchain in settlement, and crowdfunding.
topics: Bangladesh Bank Green Banking policy guidelines and mandatory refinancing schemes
Green bonds and sustainability-linked debt: Issuance criteria, verification, greenium
Integrating ESG criteria into corporate cost of capital and DCF valuation
Climate-related financial risks: Physical risks vs transition risks
FinTech ecosystem in Bangladesh: MFS, digital credit, peer-to-peer lending
Blockchain and distributed ledger technology (DLT) in international trade finance and remittances
learningOutcomes: Apply green banking criteria to evaluate project financing proposals.
Explain the pricing and structuring of green bonds in Bangladesh.
Assess FinTech business models and regulatory sandboxes.
checklists: Read Green Finance, ESG Integration & Financial Technology in ICAB Study Manual
resources: Relevant Acts & Standards (IFRS / ISA / Tax Acts)
